description: This file is a shell script that defines a test case for Git, specifically testing the behavior of Git when it detects missing commit objects in a repository. It includes setup commands to create commits and tags, removes an object to simulate corruption, and runs various Git commands to verify that they fail appropriately under these conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided shell commands, and marks the test as successful if commands pass.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail; the test passes if the command fails.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: A helper function, likely used to advance the commit timestamp for testing purposes.
